title: Professional Email
subtitle: Following up on a project request — for English learners

sentences.en: Dear Mr. Patel, I hope this email finds you well.
sentences.target: Dear Mr. Patel, I hope this email finds you well.

sentences.en: I wanted to follow up on the proposal I sent over last Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.target: I wanted to follow up on the proposal I sent over last Tuesday afternoon.

sentences.en: I understand you've been busy, so I appreciate you taking the time to review it.
sentences.target: I understand you've been busy, so I appreciate you taking the time to review it.

sentences.en: Were there any sections that you'd like me to clarify or expand on?
sentences.target: Were there any sections that you'd like me to clarify or expand on?

sentences.en: I'm happy to revise the timeline if your team needs additional flexibility.
sentences.target: I'm happy to revise the timeline if your team needs additional flexibility.

sentences.en: I'd also like to suggest a brief call later this week if that works for you.
sentences.target: I'd also like to suggest a brief call later this week if that works for you.

sentences.en: I'm available on Thursday or Friday between ten and three, your time.
sentences.target: I'm available on Thursday or Friday between ten and three, your time.

sentences.en: Please let me know which time works best, and I'll send a calendar invitation.
sentences.target: Please let me know which time works best, and I'll send a calendar invitation.

sentences.en: In the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions.
sentences.target: In the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out with any questions.

sentences.en: Thank you again for considering our proposal. I look forward to hearing from you.
sentences.target: Thank you again for considering our proposal. I look forward to hearing from you.

sentences.en: Best regards, and have a wonderful rest of your week.
sentences.target: Best regards, and have a wonderful rest of your week.
